scope: task-only curl OSS HTTP adapter; no shared source or credentials changed
cause: SDK completion request omits Content-Type; curl --data-binary adds application/x-www-form-urlencoded unless explicitly suppressed. Server rejected multipart completion with SignatureDoesNotMatch while all 32 exact parts were already present.
change: Suppress curl default Content-Type when SDK POST body does not supply one. SDK signing, CRC, source digest, exact object version and final full remote SHA checks remain native.
bounded_recovery: one completion retry after correcting the evidenced signing mismatch, reusing the same 32 verified parts and multipart ID; initial HEAD and list-parts reconciliation remain native
